alternatives.transformation: One main-projection contraction reads three auxiliary sources through the ordered row plan directly, avoiding private row-selected copies/concat where unobserved.
alternatives.argument: [S_I A0 | S_I A1 | S_I A2] = S_I [A0|A1|A2], including repeated valid indices and original order. Preserve a single15360D contraction and BF16 output boundary.
alternatives.limits: Not three separately rounded BF16 GEMMs plus adds. Bounds/negative-index behavior, readonly generations and all raw auxiliary observers remain conditions.

alternatives.transformation: Let full-row norm read rank-major gather shards directly, or have collective layout publication supply the norm layout; avoid a private transpose where legal.
alternatives.argument: Read value[p,m,c] as feature p*640+c of row m. Reduce all8 shards for the5120D norm and apply matching gamma/eps before publishing BF16 output.
alternatives.limits: For M>1 [8,M,640] is not a contiguous [M,5120] view. Full row readiness/global reduction is still required; local640 norms are invalid.

alternatives.transformation: Publish final norm prefix directly into the existing persistent context bank, or redesign the explicit precompute input ABI to consume the norm output.
alternatives.argument: For original context count Nc, an equivalent normal write of norm_output[:Nc] to the same bank prefix can replace a separate prefix copy if no intermediate observer or alias sees the temporary.
alternatives.limits: Keep original source Nc, unchanged tail, captured address/stride, readiness, all bank consumers and metadata274. Only24 TensorMove are positively counted here; no claim88 copy kernels removed.

alternatives.transformation: Replicate complete main weight; project each rank physical auxiliary rows to full5120 features, normalize locally, then exchange rows and apply the original ordered selector.
alternatives.argument: Projection and full-feature RMSNorm are row-local. With complete W and same per-row arithmetic, S_I f(A)=f(S_I A).
alternatives.limits: A640-output shard cannot do this alone. Complete weight150MiB/rank versus18.75MiB shard, extra131.25MiB logical weight. Computing N physical rows before an M-row selector costs N/M projection work; padding/extra rows/earlier overlap and quantization metadata matter.

alternatives.transformation: Retain640-feature partitions and use a global norm-statistic reduction plus partition-aware downstream KV consumers.
alternatives.argument: For already rounded BF16 projection y, s=sum_p sum_c float(y_p,c)^2 determines full-row denominator; local gamma can be applied after global s. KV partial outputs then need their own global sum/consumer protocol.
alternatives.limits: FP32 reduction/native RMS order and BF16 outputs must be preserved or numerically validated. Gathering full context afterward adds a collective without reducing activation volume; three FP32 KV AllReduces may exceed the current BF16 feature AllGather.

alternatives.transformation: Fuse private KV512 norm, 64-tail rotary result assembly and standard cache row publication, retaining original numerical stages.
alternatives.argument: Each512-row normalization and BF16 barrier precedes the same64D interleaved rotary; private448+64 assembly can be represented as the same cache-row stores.
alternatives.limits: Keep ViewCopy effects unless the original tail is proved private. Packed-cache writer, negative slots, duplicate-slot input order, current-query writers and SWA readiness remain separate domains.

alternatives.transformation: Pack three distinct KV weights into one1536-output contraction with three512D norms, or pipeline per-layer preparation/consumption.
alternatives.argument: A block concatenation of three output-channel weight matrices represents the three independent linear maps in real algebra; common context loads can be shared.
alternatives.limits: Distinct matrices remain distinct. BF16 contraction outputs and separate512D norms/configs/caches remain. Joint output readiness may delay first-layer consumption; joint and streaming gains overlap and are not additive.

alternatives.transformation: Use existing required-config filtering and/or hoist one FP32 RoPE query over the context-KV loop, selecting each layer entry afterward.
alternatives.argument: Default query185/186 is a pure lookup of stable tables at stable position values. A query for the union of requested configs contains each selected layer result; layers need not share one config.
alternatives.limits: Source same Tensor argument is not mutation/readiness proof. Preserve layer/group rules, bounds/errors for the chosen normal domain and readonly C/S. Filtering and hoisting overlap. No automatic internal Cast removal or cross-iteration address-only cache.

alternatives.transformation: Compute standard INT32 slot pairs once per shared group bank/block-size/value generation and reuse them across eligible layer caches.
alternatives.argument: f_b(s)=(-1,-1) for s<0, else(floor(s/b),s%b) is independent of layer values; same group bank and stable b/s epoch gives identical metadata.
alternatives.limits: Actual _layer_group_idx values are unknown. Different groups/block sizes/slot generations cannot be merged by shape. Per-layer cache writes remain; packed-cache route and updates to query slots are not deleted.

alternatives.transformation: After complete-weight row-local main projection/full5120 norm, compute the three replicated KV maps at row owners and gather per-layer KV rows instead of full context rows.
alternatives.argument: Each row-local KV/norm/RoPE can commute with an ordered row exchange when every owner uses the same per-layer parameters and correct post-metadata position for that row. Receivers then execute the original slot-write input sequence.
alternatives.limits: ReplicatedLinear declaration is supporting source evidence, not measured equality. Requires complete main W, positions/rejection/DCP row mapping, all context-bank consumers closed or retained, and unchanged cache contracts. Direct remote cache writes are a stronger different protocol.

invalid_shortcuts.claim: Move current640-output shard before SP auxiliary gather, then simply gather diagonal outputs.
invalid_shortcuts.reason: Rank p owns row block A_p and output-feature weight W_p. A_p W_p supplies only diagonal row-owner/feature-owner blocks; all A_q W_p for q!=p are missing. Need full-weight replication or explicit new input/weight/output exchange.

invalid_shortcuts.claim: Replace full5120D norm with8 independent640D norms.
invalid_shortcuts.reason: Denominators differ. Toy full row[1,2],gamma1,eps0 yields[1/sqrt(2.5),2/sqrt(2.5)] whereas independent one-feature norms yield[1,1]. Toy is not an actual epsilon/domain assertion.

invalid_shortcuts.claim: Split15360D contraction into three separately BF16-rounded contributions and add without a precision proof.
invalid_shortcuts.reason: Rounding is nonlinear. Under BF16 nearest-even toy contributions1+2^-8,-1,0, separately rounded contributions sum0, while BF16 of the full real sum is2^-8. This illustrates the barrier, not loaded native accumulation order.

invalid_shortcuts.claim: Reuse one KV result or normalize concatenated1536 features.
invalid_shortcuts.reason: Three layers have distinct weights/norm parameters/caches. Joint contraction preserves three results and three512D normalization domains.

invalid_shortcuts.claim: Smaller KV dimension guarantees lower communication.
invalid_shortcuts.reason: Under a ring payload illustration three512D FP32 AllReduces send10752 bytes/row/rank, while a5120D BF16 AllGather sends8960; ratio1.2 before any metadata/latency. Actual algorithm and physical performance unmeasured.

invalid_shortcuts.claim: Use same pointer/shape to cache across iterations, or skip stores when slots look unchanged.
invalid_shortcuts.reason: Position values, request/accept/reject/slot generation, layer weight/config generation, last readers and current-query writes can change at the same address. Existing KV caching is not a new optimization.

relationships: Indirect main input overlaps row-selection/concat materialization; do not add separate savings twice.
Gather-aware norm and direct bank output can compose, but the same transpose/copy/output temporary is counted once.
Complete-weight row owner and feature-sharded global-statistic protocols are ownership alternatives, not additive.
Row-owner-KV subsumes row-context gather only if no required full-context bank reader remains; keeping that gather defeats the corresponding claimed communication removal.
Config filtering, within-invocation query hoisting and mutable preallocated query buffers are overlapping choices with different alias contracts.
Joint1536-output GEMM and per-layer streaming trade common-input reuse against earlier readiness. An altered launch schedule is not free overlap.
F31 group slot-pair metadata sharing is linked to F29 rather than counted as a new model candidate.
